Tag each variable with the topics it measures.

Topics, grouped by area. Use only these ids:

## Demographics
- age: Age — Age or date of birth.
- gender: Sex and gender — Sex or gender.

## Health
- smoking: Smoking — Tobacco use.
- alcohol: Alcohol — Drinking alcohol.
- physical_health: Physical health — Conditions, height, weight.

## Survey administration
- identifiers: Identifiers — Person and household identifiers.
- survey_weights: Survey weights — Weights and design variables.
- other: Other — Nothing else fits.

Rules:
- Each line of the next message is one variable: its id, name, label and value labels.
- Reply with every variable's id and its topics, each with a confidence from 0 to 1.
- Give every variable at least one topic. If nothing fits, use `other` with a low confidence.

The output should be formatted as a JSON instance that conforms to the JSON schema below.

As an example, for the schema {"properties": {"foo": {"title": "Foo", "description": "a list of strings", "type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}}, "required": ["foo"]}
the object {"foo": ["bar", "baz"]} is a well-formatted instance of the schema. The object {"properties": {"foo": ["bar", "baz"]}} is not well-formatted.

Here is the output schema:
```
{"$defs": {"TopicTag": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"topic": {"enum": ["age", "gender", "smoking", "alcohol", "physical_health", "identifiers", "survey_weights", "other"], "title": "Topic", "type": "string"}, "confidence": {"maximum": 1, "minimum": 0, "title": "Confidence", "type": "number"}}, "required": ["topic", "confidence"], "title": "TopicTag", "type": "object"}, "VariableTags": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"id": {"title": "Id", "type": "integer"}, "topics": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/TopicTag"}, "title": "Topics", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["id", "topics"], "title": "VariableTags", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"variables": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/VariableTags"}, "title": "Variables", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["variables"]}
```
